historicalCause: V2.6 and V2.7.5 were separate pages and implementations
V2.7.5 rebuilt a mesh whenever the selected profile or a rebuild control changed
the old renderer requested animation frames continuously even while idle
r310Fix: high variation moved to one parameter preset on old-pbr-fired
mesh build results cached by profile, seed, controls, level and quality
LRU memory cache keeps six generated meshes
renderer redraws only after input, camera motion, resize or active auto rotation
recalculation.scopeLimit: The mesh cache is in-memory for the current brick-lab page. Closing or destroying that page intentionally releases its WebGL context and cache to prevent GPU-memory accumulation, so the first visit after a complete page reload still calculates once.

performance.portalRule: Only one nested WebGL workbench exists at a time. Switching destroys the old iframe and context before creating the next one.
